description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAssign class, which implements the clearAssign() method used to clear assigned template variables in Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAssign
classes.description: A class providing method to clear assigned variables in Smarty templates.

methods.name: clearAssign
methods.description: Clears specified template variables from the data object, either singly or in batch.
